description: This file is a shell script that manages syslog configurations, including setting log levels, configuring targets for Docsis and kernel logs, and restarting syslog services based on user input.

methods.name: get_log_level
methods.description: Reads user input to set the log level variable based on selected severity

methods.name: start_syslog
methods.description: Sets up the syslog configuration file and starts syslog daemon with appropriate log level

methods.name: set_docsis_target
methods.description: Configures the documentation system log target and appends the configuration to syslog conf file

methods.name: set_kern_target
methods.description: Configures the kernel log target and updates syslog configuration

methods.name: ask_reboot
methods.description: Prompts the user whether to restart syslog services and performs restart if confirmed
